-क्तः One who is finally emancipated from the bonds [Page1273-2] of worldly existence, one who has renounced all worldly attachments and secured final beatitude, an absolved saint; सुभाषितेन गीतेन युबतीनां च लीलया । मनो न भिद्यते यस्य स वै मुक्तोऽथवा पशुः ॥ [[Subhāṣ.]] 
-क्तम् The spirit released from worldly existence. 
-Comp.
